name: Yami Yuuenchi de Kakurenbo ~Matabiraki no Yoru~
original_name: 闇遊園地でかくれんぼ～マタビラキの夜～
source:
A regional amusement park, [Tsurumiku Attraction Park]—commonly known as [Tsurupa]—has fallen on hard times due to the emergence of powerful competitors and now faces the threat of closure.

Although it is barely managing to stay open, due to rural depopulation and a declining birthrate coupled with an aging population, the staff is small and consists almost entirely of seniors, leading to frequent sudden, unscheduled closures.

One day, a burly-looking man applied in response to a job posting that had been up for some time, even though the management had all but given up hope.

The man arrived with a group of friends, and when they declared, “If you provide us with basic food, shelter, and clothing, we’ll take over management ourselves,” the owner saw a glimmer of hope for turning the situation around and decided to completely overhaul the staff.

The men were given the park’s management office as a place to live. They made improvements to make it more livable and set out to manage the park 24 hours a day while working to streamline operations.

The owner, who had hoped “at least things would stabilize,” was overjoyed to see business gradually improving and ended up leaving everything entirely in their hands.

However, unbeknownst to him, “Tsuru-Pa” was beginning to transform into a terrifying, shadowy amusement park—
translation:
地方游乐园“鹤见区游乐园”——俗称“鹤园”——在实力雄厚的竞争对手冲击下经营惨淡，如今正面临倒闭关停的危机。

尽管还在苦苦支撑着勉强营业，但在地方人口流失与少子老龄化的双重打击下，园内员工寥寥无几，且几乎清一色都是上了年纪的老人，三天两头便会毫无征兆地临时休园。

某天，面对那则挂了许久、连管理层都早已不抱希望的招聘启事，一名体格魁梧的壮汉突然上门应聘。

这名壮汉还带来了一帮同伙，拍着胸脯宣称：“只要管我们基本的吃穿住行，整座游乐园的运营管理就交给我们全权包揽吧！”正愁走投无路的园长仿佛抓住了起死回生的一线曙光，当即拍板对员工阵容进行了大换血。

这伙男人获准住进园内的管理事务所，不仅动手将屋子改造得更加宜居，更着手推行全天24小时驻园管理与业务精简改革。

原本只指望“至少能让经营稳定下来就好”的园长，眼看着业绩日渐回暖不由得欣喜若狂，索性当起了甩手掌柜，将园内大小事务彻彻底底交到了这伙人手中。

殊不知在园长毫不知情的暗处，“鹤园”正悄然蜕变为一座令人毛骨悚然的暗黑游乐园——
